# A module whose path is github.com/typelate/muxt, such as a fork older
# than the CLI, gets no muxt requirement in the coverage pre-pass's
# modfile copy, so the shim's import of template/html resolves inside the
# module itself. When the module has no template/html, the probe says so,
# coverage is unknown, and every mutant runs.

! muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
stderr '(?m)^warning: template coverage unknown: the module under test is github.com/typelate/muxt without template/html; the pre-pass needs the engine packages of muxt '
cmp stdout want.txt

-- go.mod --
module github.com/typelate/muxt

go 1.27
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "page"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{if .Admin}} {{.Secret}}{{end}}{{end}}
-- template.go --
package muxt

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name   string
	Admin  bool
	Secret string
}

func Render(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "page", page)
}
